release_notes: `reconcile()` classified every active state-file leg against `broker_map` even when that broker's `positions()` call itself failed (rate limit, session dead, ...) — since `broker_map` ends up empty for that broker, every genuinely-open leg failed the match and was reported as `orphan_state` ("state active, broker empty"), even though the broker was never actually asked successfully. Confirmed live 2026-09-08: Breeze's daily-quota exhaustion made `positions()` raise, and the dashboard flagged 4 real open `DIB_07_Jul_2026_v2_Breeze` legs as vanished when the broker held them the whole time. Legs for a broker whose fetch failed are now skipped from classification entirely — only `error` surfaces the failure. Also fixed the dashboard badge/JS, which would otherwise have rendered that as "0 mismatch"/"clean" instead of surfacing the error.
